column1: # M3_TO_JDK_LAYOUT content protection: files whose bytes refs does not rewrite (they still move like any other file).
# A recipe's rule tables, rename ledgers and replayed fixtures record the transformation they made: the old paths in
# them are data, and rewriting them breaks the replay. Columns (tab separated):
#   regex over the old or the new path
# mode bytes: never rewritten. mode fixture: a test whose m3/... literals are inputs of the recorded rename (synthetic
# trees), so only its own location (relative forms, __file__ parents) follows the move.
